title: Flash Eurobarometer: Europeans call for stronger action on children's online safety, democratic resilience, defence, and the energy transition
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Jul 2026 A new Eurobarometer survey released today shows that Europeans are overwhelmingly concerned about all the risks children face on social media. Against the backdrop of increasing reliance on social media, citizens see the need for better protection and tougher action to tackle disinformation.

title: Commission approves French State aid to support offshore wind energy
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 13 Jul 2026 The European Commission has approved a €63 billion French scheme to support offshore wind energy in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal. This measure will contribute to the transition towards a net-zero economy. The scheme was approved under the Clean Industrial Deal State Aid Framework (CISAF) adopted by the Commission on 25 June 2025.
